verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents a built-in agent that lets users explore segments and analyze campaign performance in natural language inside the product, which covers in-product insights. AI Decisioning uses reinforcement learning to recommend the best message, channel, and timing per customer, which covers suggestions. The MCP server provides similar analysis through external assistants, but that sits outside the product. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the built-in agent's insight and suggestion capabilities (it rests on a single overview mention), and independent or hands-on corroboration of either feature.
